items.title: Analytics Workflow
items.description: Turn a business question into a data problem, get data into R, and structure analysis so it can be repeated.

items.title: Data Wrangling
items.description: Filter, group, aggregate, join, and reshape data with the tidyverse mindset expressed in base R.

items.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
items.description: Probe distributions, spot outliers, measure spread, and quantify relationships between variables.

items.title: Statistical Analysis
items.description: Sample data, build confidence intervals, run basic hypothesis checks, and fit simple regression lines.

items.title: Analytics Project
items.description: Pull the whole workflow together: choose a dataset, analyze it, and report data-driven recommendations.
